family.description: This entry includes microtubule-associated tyrosine carboxypeptidases, proteins that remove the C-terminal tyrosine residue of alpha-tubulin, thereby regulating microtubule dynamics and function [[cite:PUB00101358]]. They are also able to remove the C-terminal phenylalanine residue of alpha-tubulin TUBA8 [[cite:PUB00101358]]. These proteins recognise adjacent tubulin dimers along the same protofilament [[cite:PUB00101358]].
family.name: Microtubule-associated tyrosine carboxypeptidase
